courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以螺距比較的共同進速比建立起點，接到葉片力矩的簡化力臂的系統介面，最後用螺距曲線的適用界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Common advance ratio for pitch comparison, connect through Simplified blade-force lever arm, then integrate evidence using Applicability boundaries of pitch curves. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船用可調螺距螺槳
history.text: 本專題以螺距比較的共同進速比建立起點，接到葉片力矩的簡化力臂的系統介面，最後用螺距曲線的適用界線整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Common advance ratio for pitch comparison, connect through Simplified blade-force lever arm, then integrate evidence using Applicability boundaries of pitch curves. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以假想開水域曲線比較可調螺距的操作區，不把螺距刻度直接等同推力。 在螺距與推進曲線資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Compare controllable-pitch regions using synthetic open-water curves rather than equating pitch setting with thrust. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Pitch and propulsion-curve data studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
